before: Every highlight set composites with multiply over light paper (screen over dark), so no set can dim or hide the text under it.
after: HighlightOptions.blend: 'tint' keeps that compositing as one group; 'cover' paints as is, above every tint set, so a page-colored fill dims the text (a focus veil) and an opaque one hides it.
reason: View state only: highlights are never saved, never reach an operation and are not shared with collaborators.
